newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums stay up, Russian cargoes talked.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums stay up, Russian cargoes talked.

text.p: NWE jet prices rose in line with IPE gas oil futures, and supply remained tight, dealers said. Cargoes delivered in northern Europe were talked at October IPE gas oil futures +$36/37 cif, with one requirement heard into the U.K., but very few cargoes were making the trip from the Mediterranean.
Russian blending material from Ventspils was talked around $4.00 discount to cif benchmark quotes cif ARA.
